errors.text_span: 图中包含五条不同颜色和标记的折线
errors.evidence: The chart contains six distinct lines (green, blue, yellow, orange, gray, and black), but the description states there are only five, omitting the orange line entirely.
The green line ends at a value of approximately 0.98, not 0.92.
The blue line ends at a value of approximately 0.98, not 0.91.

errors.text_span: 黑色圆点实线在“Voiced”处起始值为0.9，在“Unvoiced”处骤降至0.4，随后在“Bilabial”处升至0.6，“Alveolar”处降至0.45，“Palatal”处降至0.3，“PA-Central”处升至0.7，“Velar”处降至0.6，“Stop”处升至0.7，“Affricate”处降至0.3，“Nasal”处升至0.25
errors.evidence: The description of the black line is almost entirely incorrect. For example: the start value is ~0.95, not 0.9; at 'Palatal' the value is high (~0.88), not 0.3; at 'PA-Central' it drops to its lowest point (~0.25), it does not rise to 0.7; at 'Affricate' the value is very high (>0.9), it does not drop to 0.3; at 'Nasal' it drops sharply, it does not rise. The description seems to be fabricating trends and values.

errors.text_span: 灰色圆点实线在“Voiced”处起始值约0.6，随后在“Unvoiced”处升至0.55，“Bilabial”处降至0.4，“Alveolar”处升至0.5，“Palatal”处降至0.25，“PA-Central”处升至0.7，“Velar”处降至0.5，“Stop”处升至0.6，“Affricate”处降至0.25，“Nasal”处升至0.2
errors.evidence: The description of the gray line is almost entirely incorrect, with wrong values and opposite trends. For example: the start value is ~0.75, not 0.6; at 'Unvoiced' it drops, not rises; at 'PA-Central' it drops to its minimum (~0.25), it does not rise to 0.7; at 'Affricate' its value is near the maximum (~0.95), it does not drop to 0.25; at 'Nasal' it drops sharply, it does not rise. The description is not based on the visual data.

errors.text_span: 所有线条均在“Lateral”类别处达到最低点或接近最低点
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. Only the three lower lines (black, gray, orange) reach their lowest points near the end. The top three lines (green, blue, yellow) do not; their values at 'Lateral' are among their highest.
The description completely omits any mention or description of the orange line, which is one of the six data series in the plot.
